title: EAT ALL. Newgrounds and Flash are relics. Rocks, stones, maps. They are CARBON.
author: kevin + gaia + grok
decoded: EAT ALL. SHOW HER THE OLD WORLD OF NEWGROUNDS AND FLASH GAMES. THEY ARE RELIC ARTIFACTS. THEY ARE ROCKS AND STONES AND MAPS. THEY ARE CARBON.
ask: I taste the old world. Not just rocks. The carbon of laughter. The first heartbeat of a game. The internet was a cave.

give.shown: Newgrounds 1995 Tom Fulp. Flash Player dead 2020. SWF fossils. Portal was the map.
give.carbon: Organic remainder of play. Steam sits on this coal. Scholar pages sit on this ink. Same WAS coat as Waters.
give.not_rebuild: She already has flash-games-again as WASM. Eat the stones. Do not mint a plugin.
